# Track A (FCLR-010) fixture-driven dry-run fixtures

Synthetic, leakage-resistant panels for validating the frozen FCLR-010 harness
WITHOUT network access or the ironflow census. Pure Python (no pandas/pyarrow
required in this repo's environment), so the dry-run is reproducible on a clean
clone.

## Files
- `panel_train.jsonl`  — train split rows (2025-11-01..2026-03-06)
- `panel_val.jsonl`    — validation split rows (2026-03-14..2026-05-20)
- `panel_test.jsonl`   — test split rows (2026-05-28..2026-10-31)
- `manifest.json`      — frozen split boundaries + schema contract

## Schema contract (one JSON object per line)
{"timestamp":"2026-05-28T00:00:00Z","symbol":"BTC-PERP","mark_price":30000.0,
 "funding_rate":0.0001,"liquidation_count":0,"notional_usd":0.0,"side":"long"}

Rows are generated by `scripts/generate_tracka_fixtures.py` from a deterministic
seed; every feature is computed from strictly-prior rows only (no future peeking),
so the dry-run can assert leakage safety.
